summary: Your Pro licence unlocks every Pro feature, the engine grows with your tenant, and the database no longer runs full.

new.title: Home shows your setup health
new.text: Home now flags a critical setting that is missing or wrong, such as no alert recipient, with what to do. Pro installs can share the same report with Invardia support.

new.title: Licence page explains each Pro feature
new.text: Settings > Licence now shows beside each Pro feature why it is included or what licence it needs.

new.title: Engine sized for your tenant automatically
new.text: PIM Manager sizes the engine for your number of users, groups and apps at install and on every update, and raises it after an out-of-memory run.

new.title: Re-issued licences install themselves
new.text: When Invardia re-issues your licence, your installation fetches and checks it within 30 minutes, with no action from you.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: The delegation wizard asks for a per-environment workload's target, a script sets the database tier, and support sees database space, update ring and failure causes.

fixes.title: Pro licence covers every Pro feature
fixes.text: Features added after your licence was issued showed as "Pro - not licensed". Your edition now unlocks every current and future feature it includes.

fixes.title: The database no longer runs full
fixes.text: A database raised from Basic kept a 2 GB limit and stopped accepting changes when full. Every Standard database now gets a 250 GB maximum at no extra cost.

fixes.title: Large tenants no longer run out of memory
fixes.text: The list behind Reviews & controls > Revoke could stop with an out-of-memory error on very large tenants. It now completes using far less memory.

fixes.title: Removing an unapplied workload binding works
fixes.text: A workload binding PIM Manager never applied can now be removed cleanly, and it disappears from Failing now.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Pro is always recognised during updates, the end-of-install licence check is correct, the mail sender shows its chosen address, and install progress shows every step.
